title: Fluorescent In Vitro Model to Assess Adhesion of Bd to A6 Cells
author: Elin Verbrugghe
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8thhwj6

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium A
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum to obtain a final composition of 70 % L15, 20 % distilled water, and 10 % fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Medium B
steps.instruction: Mix L15 medium, distilled water, and fetal bovine serum to obtain a final composition of 40 % L15, 55 % distilled water, and 5 % fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Coat Coverslips with Collagen
steps.instruction: Place glass coverslips in a 24‑well tissue‑culture plate, add 200 µL collagen‑coating solution per well, incubate at 37 °C for 2 h, then rinse the coated surface twice with HBSS‑. Use immediately or air‑dry and store at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Stain and Prepare A6 Cells
steps.instruction: Perform the following actions in darkness:

substeps.instruction: Detach A6 cells from a culture flask using trypsin.
Centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm.
Wash cells with 70 % HBSS‑ and centrifuge again 5 min at 1500 rpm.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL of 3 µM CellTracker Green CMFDA prepared in Cell Medium A.
Incubate 45 min at 26 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm, 26 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 70 % HBSS‑ and count cells.
Centrifuge 5 min at 1500 rpm.
Resuspend cells in Cell Medium A to a concentration of 1 × 10⁵ cells / mL.
Seed 1 mL (1 × 10⁵ cells) per well onto the collagen‑coated coverslip.
Incubate 2 h at 26 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow attachment.
After 2 h, wash cells with 70 % HBSS+.
Include a control well to monitor cells throughout the protocol.
Isolate Bd zoospores and spin 5 min at 3000 rpm, 20 °C.
Remove supernatant, resuspend spores in Cell Medium B, and count them.
Dilute spores to 1 × 10⁶ spores / mL in Cell Medium B.
Note: Bd zoospores lose motility in Cell Medium A.
Include a control well to assess spore motility by light microscopy.
Add 1 mL of the spore suspension (1 × 10⁶ spores) to each well containing CellTracker‑labelled A6 cells (MOI = 10:1).
Incubate 2 h at 20 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Gently wash infected cells three times with 70 % HBSS+ to remove non‑adherent spores.
Replace Cell Medium B with Cell Medium A and incubate an additional 2 h to assess adhesion.
Use the control well to check spore adhesion by light microscopy.

steps.title: Visualize Bd Adhesion
steps.instruction: At 4 h post‑infection (2 h in Medium B + 2 h in Medium A), execute:

substeps.instruction: Wash infected cells three times with 70 % HBSS+.
Add 200 µL Calcofluor White (10 µg / mL in 70 % HBSS) and incubate 10 min (dark).
Wash three times with 70 % HBSS+.
Fix cells with 0.5 mL 3 % paraformaldehyde for 10 min.
Wash twice with 70 % HBSS+.
Mount coverslips using ProLong Gold antifade mountant.
Analyze Bd‑A6 interactions by fluorescence microscopy.
